name: Universal Intermodal Services - Dearborn Terminal - Dearborn MI

fieldNotes.facility: Universal Intermodal Services drayage / intermodal terminal at 4440 Wyoming Ave (St), Dearborn MI — a 10-K named owned terminal property. Per Universal Intermodal's own description these are 'secure container yards coupled with maintenance and repair facilities offering container storage.' Confirmed via loadmatch.com directory and a Universal-branded sign visible at the yard entrance in 2025 Street View. The roster geocode landed on a small red-roofed office building on the west side of Wyoming Ave; the operational terminal yard is the large fenced container/chassis lot on the east side of Wyoming.
fieldNotes.type: This is an intermodal/drayage CONTAINER YARD, not a dock-door warehouse — it stores and stages ocean/domestic containers and chassis and contains a container maintenance & repair (M&R) building. dockDoors classified NONE accordingly.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The yard is fully fenced (chain-link along Wyoming Ave, confirmed in 2025 Street View) with wide controlled driveway openings / sliding gates and a Universal-branded sign at the entrance. Truck access is gated. Estimated ~2 gate openings along the Wyoming Ave frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth resolves at the gate openings in imagery or Street View. Container/drayage yards of this type typically run a gate-clerk kiosk / OCR check rather than a manned shack -> remoteGs true. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The yard is wall-to-wall container, chassis and trailer storage — hundreds of units parked across multiple gravel/paved lots -> 50+ band; the whole site is a drop yard.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-element terminal: a long maintenance/repair building, an office, and several distinct container/chassis storage sub-yards.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly resolved; intermodal terminals sometimes have one but none confirmed here -> left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs through the broader district to the south, but no rail spur is visible entering this drayage yard (drayage terminals move containers by truck to/from separate rail ramps) -> railServed false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large open yard apron and wide gate openings leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~41 acres for the fenced Universal terminal parcel; the surrounding corridor holds other operators' yards and is excluded.
